deals.sourceText: Samsung's Odyssey OLED G5 27" gaming monitor is $180 off at Amazon. At $320, it sits below its 90-day average of $347. The QD-OLED panel runs at 1440p and 180Hz with a 0.03ms response time, and it works with both FreeSync and G-Sync. Shipping is free. deals.title: Anker Prime 14-Port Docking Station w/ Anker 621 5,000mAh MagGo Power Bank for $170 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: Anker's Black Friday sale has the Anker Prime 14-in-1 Charging Docking Station at $170 for members, which is $100 off. (It's free to join.) Plus, you'll get the Anker 621 5,000mAh MagGo Power Bank for free. That's $53 under what Amazon charges for these items sold separately. The dock adds 14 ports, including dual HDMI outputs, for one-cable laptop setups. It ships for free. Deal ends November 18.
